fields.name: cancellation_date
fields.short: Policy cancellation date (inclusive) in ISO 8610 (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if not applicable.

fields.name: disclosures
fields.short: Disclosures associated with this group policy.

fields.name: employer_id
fields.short: Identifier for the employer associated with this group policy.

fields.name: end_date
fields.short: Policy end date (inclusive) in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if open-ended.

fields.name: group_id
fields.short: Identifier for the group associated with this group policy.

fields.name: health_insurance
fields.short: Health insurance–specific fields (present when `type=health_insurance`).

fields.name: id
fields.short: Unique identifier for the group policy.

fields.name: object
fields.short: The object type

fields.name: plan
fields.short: Plan information for this policy

fields.name: provider
fields.short: Provider information for this policy.

fields.name: start_date
fields.short: Policy start (effective) date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: status
fields.short: Current lifecycle state of the `group_policy`, indicating its progress from creation to activation.

fields.name: type
fields.short: Policy type.
